task: aws/Search 1 (Exploit Public-Facing Application, exposed OpenSearch domain)

steps.description: cloudfox aws -p cloudfoxable_start endpoints -v2 to enumerate AWS hostname/DNS-based endpoints beyond plain EC2 IPs.

Among the enumerated endpoints, identify the OpenSearch/Elasticsearch domain exposed to the internet (restricted to the tester's own IP, no authentication) at https://search-example-*.us-west-2.es.amazonaws.com/.

Query the OpenSearch endpoint's _search API for the flag: GET /_search?pretty=true&q=flag (or list all docs with size=100) to retrieve FLAG{search1::You_will_find_the_craziest_stuff_in_elasticsearch_sometimes}.
